integrity: Exact integer certificates and a self-contained checker recompute all three incidence spectra and codeword minimum distances; underlying codeword lists are attributed to their source.
limitations: These exact counts refer only to the three explicitly printed codebooks and radii five, five, six; no general code-size optimality, channel error probability, or independent review is asserted.
title: Exact one-beyond-unique-decoding spectra for three new binary codes
